_doc: fpf_trimul_v4 launch cells keyed '<cc major.minor>|<triton major.minor>' (never key by cc alone: the Triton version selects the load path). k1 = LN_in + dual gated projection (_k1c pointer loads, or _k1t TMA descriptor loads when impl='tma'); k3 = _k3c epilogue. Lookup order: exact 'cc|triton' -> 'cc|*' (pointer-load cell valid for any triton >= 3.3 on that cc; printed as generic) -> '*|*' (ef2_w4._t9_load: the '*|*' row is the table's DEFAULT cell — it serves a capability or triton no measured row names, named on the T9 line as such; a cell that cannot compile or launch on the device is disabled by name by ef2_w4's probe launch, never silently) -> no row -> STOCK forward. A row's status word (TESTED… for a measured row, DEFAULT… for the default) is carried onto the T9 line, never a gate. The 8.0 rows (A100-80GB, pointer loads; 'overrides' = the core resolver's per-(C,D)-class refinement, k1_C<C>_D<D>) are the shared core's A100 sweep on this stack (torch 2.13.0+cu130 / triton 3.7.1): 92/92 cases within the kernel's tier vs the torch module, run-to-run and graph-replay equal, 48/48 timings not slower.

*|*.status: DEFAULT: no measured row for this capability or triton — the single-stage pointer-load cell (the 10.0|* values); ef2_w4 names it on the T9 line and its probe launch keeps T9 on only where the cell compiles and launches
